name: Steak & garlic butter mash
steps: Season the steak generously and sear in a hot pan with oil, 3 minutes each side.
Add butter and crushed garlic to the pan and baste the steak as it rests.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then drain well.
Mash the potatoes with the garlic butter from the pan until smooth.
Slice the steak against the grain and serve over the mash.
